clusters.headline: President Ruto Nominates New Data Commissioner And State CEOs
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto has nominated Lydia Sitienei Chelagat to serve as the new Data Commissioner.
The nomination has been submitted to the Kenyan Parliament for formal review and consideration.

clusters.headline: Kenyan Cult Leader Receives 200 Year Sentence For Shakahola Deaths
aiSummaryBullets: Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years in prison for his role in the deaths of 191 individuals.
The judicial decision follows a conviction on 191 counts of murder issued by the court on October 19, 2026.

clusters.headline: Kenya Discharges Final Ebola Patient As Disease-Free Status Nears
aiSummaryBullets: Kenya has successfully discharged the last of its nine confirmed Ebola patients from hospital care.
Health authorities have officially initiated a 42-day observation period to monitor for any potential resurgence of the virus.

clusters.headline: Lawyer Abshir Abdi Testifies Following Abduction And Rescue
aiSummaryBullets: Lawyer Abshir Abdi appeared at the Milimani Law Courts to recount his experience following his recent abduction.
Abdi, along with another individual named Ayub Maalim, provided testimony to Justice Alexander Muteti regarding the circumstances of their ordeal.

clusters.headline: Three Dead And Eleven Injured In Nairobi Riverside Wall Collapse
aiSummaryBullets: A wall at a construction site in Nairobi's Riverside district collapsed during excavation work.
Emergency response teams and the Kenya Red Cross confirmed three fatalities and eleven injuries.

clusters.headline: Pope Francis Names Bishop Obanyi As Archbishop Of Eldoret Province
aiSummaryBullets: Pope Francis has formally elevated the Diocese of Eldoret to the status of a Metropolitan Archdiocese.
Bishop Obanyi has been named as the inaugural Metropolitan Archbishop to lead the newly created ecclesiastical province.

clusters.headline: President Ruto Criticizes Gachagua Regarding Young Political Leaders
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto publicly urged former Deputy President Rigathi Gachagua to cease interfering with the careers of young politicians.
The President stated his intention to support upcoming leadership and pledged to hand over power to a younger generation in 2032.

clusters.headline: Six People Confirmed Dead After Building Collapses In Syokimau
aiSummaryBullets: An eight-storey building under construction collapsed in Syokimau, Machakos County, on Friday morning.
Official reports confirm six fatalities and five people rescued from the site of the incident.

clusters.headline: US, Russia, and China Leaders to Hold Joint Talks at APEC Summit
aiSummaryBullets: President Donald Trump is traveling to Shenzhen, China, to attend the 21-member APEC summit.
The White House confirmed plans for a meeting between the leaders of the US, Russia, and China.

clusters.headline: Energy Regulator Maintains Current Fuel Prices In Kenya Monthly Review
aiSummaryBullets: The Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority announced that fuel prices will stay at current levels in Nairobi.
Petrol will continue to retail at Sh226.96 per litre for motorists.
